name: Tabor public retrieval fixture v1
quality: Top-1 cosine retrieval against four fixed candidates per query. All vectors must have 384 finite dimensions. Accepted results per hour are based on accepted queries per observed window.

cases.query: What device collects light to observe distant planets?
candidates: A telescope gathers light to show distant astronomical objects.
A thermometer measures the temperature of a liquid.
A keyboard has keys for entering characters.
An anchor holds a boat in place.

cases.query: How is rain returned to the atmosphere?
candidates: A violin produces a note when a bow moves across its strings.
Water evaporates into vapor from surfaces during the water cycle.
A screw fastens two materials together.
An electric motor uses currents and magnetic fields.

cases.query: What do bees collect from flowers to make honey?
candidates: A compass aligns with a magnetic field.
Honey bees gather flower nectar and turn it into honey.
Sandstones contain cemented grains of sand.

cases.query: How does a toothed wheel pass rotation to another shaft?
candidates: Photosynthesis converts light into stored chemical energy.
An envelope holds a letter for delivery.
Meshing gear teeth transmit rotation and torque between shafts.
